claims.sourceText: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1961-1963, Volume XXV, List of Persons, https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1961-63v25/persons
claims.text: The Department of State's own list of persons gives the office and its dates: 'Bronk, Detlev W., President of the National Academy of Sciences, 1950-1962.'

edges.label: Named as a panel member inside the disputed document
edges.note: Bronk is named as an MJ-12 member in the Eisenhower Briefing Document as read aloud on Area 52 DEBRIEFED and again by the host in a separate episode. No record opened for this node connects him to the subject; his offices are the reason he is on the board.
